name: dependency-preloaded-after-a-launcher
description: A runtime flag that preloads a module counts in a command whose program is node behind a launcher the analysis reads: env with -- and -u, cross-env with an assignment, and npx with --yes, -p and a -c command. A command the analysis does not read, behind env -S or an npx option that is not one of the few it reads, as --version is, is held: the dependency its text names is used, so no dependency a command names is reported.
